nodes.label: API vs Background Worker IPC Decoupling Principles
nodes.norm_label: api vs background worker ipc decoupling principles
nodes.rationale: Shared messageDeliveryQueue, zero IPC/network coupling, PostgreSQL as single source of truth, and crash/load isolation between API and worker pods.

nodes.label: Resilient Decoupled Delivery Principle
nodes.rationale: Core API operations and background dispatches are isolated so failures in external delivery gateways never degrade the user experience.

nodes.label: Decoupled 12-Factor Worker Architecture
nodes.rationale: HTTP API server and background processing engine run as isolated OS processes communicating asynchronously via Redis distributed queues and PostgreSQL so heavy email dispatches never block the API event loop.

nodes.label: Entry Atomicity and Repair Mode
nodes.rationale: An entry is marked applied only when all its ops succeed; any failed op rolls back edits for that entry, whereas repair mode makes minimal fixes against current source without rolling back.

nodes.label: Five Motion Continuity Failure Shapes
nodes.rationale: Audits filmstrips and layers for entrance-replay, crossfade-dip, orphan-linger, end-paint-swap, and box-shadow start-jump/end-jump artifacts that numeric box trajectories alone miss.

nodes.label: Emotional Moment Design Patterns
nodes.rationale: Calibrates responses for success, waiting, empty/first use, error/recovery, repeated interactions, and discovery while protecting task speed, accessibility, and mute preferences.

nodes.label: Single Delight Thesis
nodes.rationale: Product character is expressed through one small, product-specific interaction or detail grounded in its visual world rather than generic whimsy or unrequested friction.

nodes.label: Input Validation, Accessibility, and Performance Resilience

nodes.label: Error, Concurrency, and Interrupted Gesture Resilience
nodes.norm_label: error, concurrency, and interrupted gesture resilience

nodes.norm_label: text overflow, flex/grid min-width, and fluid type

nodes.label: Internationalization and Arabic-Script Resilience
nodes.rationale: Budgets 30-40% text expansion, uses CSS logical properties, preserves ZWNJ (U+200C), equates Persian/Arabic Yeh and Kaf variants in search, and formats numbers/calendars with Intl APIs.

nodes.label: Visitor Modes (Persuade, Operate, Read, Experience)
nodes.rationale: Choosing mode from the requested surface rather than the product scales design ambition appropriately between bold persuasion/experience and restrained precision in operate/read.

nodes.label: Native Platform Adaptation Playbook
nodes.rationale: Native adaptation restructures via size classes and translates idioms across iOS and Android rather than stretching phone layouts or transplanting foreign controls.

nodes.label: Web Context Adaptation Playbook
nodes.rationale: Adaptation requires rethinking the experience for the target device, input method, and posture rather than merely scaling pixels.

nodes.label: Purposeful Motion & Animation Playbook
nodes.rationale: Motion must explain state, relationship, and hierarchy or deliver one authored focal moment; decoration without purpose creates animation debt.

nodes.label: Bolder Design Amplification Playbook
nodes.rationale: Amplifies a flat target section by dialing up the system's existing motifs, scale, and rhythm while keeping everything outside the target untouched.

nodes.label: Craft Floor Quality Bar & Absolute Bans
nodes.norm_label: craft floor quality bar & absolute bans

nodes.label: Impeccable Documenter Role
nodes.rationale: Documents DESIGN.md from the shipped artifact rather than planned rules, and refuses to canonize craft-floor violations into house style.

nodes.label: Responsive Design & Input Detection Reference
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first min-width queries, content-driven breakpoints, pointer/hover feature detection, env() safe areas, and srcset/picture art direction handle diverse hardware without relying on device sniffing.

nodes.label: Android Slop Test
nodes.rationale: Tests whether a fluent Android user trusts the app by catching iOS idioms (bottom-only tab bars, Cupertino controls, broken predictive Back) ported onto Android.

nodes.label: Motion Thesis (Focal Moment, Continuity, Feedback, Budget)
nodes.norm_label: motion thesis (focal moment, continuity, feedback, budget)
nodes.rationale: Anchors animation choices to product meaning and runtime budget rather than generic fade-and-rise or parallax reflexes.

nodes.label: The Skeleton Test
nodes.rationale: Stripping copy out of a section verifies whether hierarchy and structural devices carry meaning without relying solely on text size.

nodes.label: State Message Hierarchy & Actionable Error Pattern
nodes.norm_label: state message hierarchy & actionable error pattern
nodes.rationale: Structures every UI state around the single needed fact, next action, supporting context, and appropriate tone, while making errors name what failed, why, and how to recover.

nodes.label: OKLCH Semantic Color Role System & WCAG Contrast
nodes.norm_label: oklch semantic color role system & wcag contrast
nodes.rationale: Builds predictable semantic surface/text/action roles in OKLCH with explicit dark-mode composition and WCAG AA contrast rather than decorative swatches or mechanical inversion.

nodes.label: Craft Floor Refuse List (Kickers Ban & Category Defaults)
nodes.norm_label: craft floor refuse list (kickers ban & category defaults)
nodes.rationale: Rejects unexamined category defaults (repeated icon cards, hero-metric templates, gradient text, side stripes, hard offset shadows outside neobrutalism, system display faces, geometric masks) and enforces an absolute ban on kickers/eyebrows.

nodes.label: Isolated Assessment A & Assessment B Orchestration
nodes.norm_label: isolated assessment a & assessment b orchestration
nodes.rationale: Keeps Assessment A's design specificity judgment isolated from Assessment B's deterministic detector output so automated findings do not anchor holistic critique.

nodes.label: Design Authority & Brief Precedence Principles
nodes.rationale: Pinned briefs win over category defaults; refinements preserve incumbent identity while redesigns treat the old look as anti-reference rather than polishing a discarded look.

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM Vault Encryption Principle
nodes.rationale: Content is strictly encrypted at rest with authenticated AES-256-GCM; unencrypted data is never leaked.

nodes.label: Polish as Refinement and Drift Classification
nodes.norm_label: polish as refinement and drift classification
nodes.rationale: Polish preserves the incumbent visual world and classifies drift into missing token, one-off implementation, conceptual mismatch, or local defect.

nodes.label: Five-Tier Defect Triage Order
nodes.rationale: Fix functional and accessibility blockers first, then missing states, then hierarchy/responsive/system drift, then visual/motion polish, and finally code/asset cleanup.

nodes.label: Quiet Without Collapsing to Generic
nodes.rationale: Reduce visual intensity across saturation (70-85%), font weights, spacing, and ease-out-quart motion while preserving hierarchy, character, and point of view.

nodes.label: Tinted Grays and Never Gray on Color
nodes.norm_label: tinted grays and never gray on color
nodes.rationale: Use warm or cool tinted grays for quiet depth, and use a darker shade of the background color rather than gray text on colored surfaces.

nodes.label: Signals-Driven Context-Aware Menu
nodes.rationale: On bare /impeccable invocation, read impeccable signals (and run detect on web scan.targets) to recommend 2-3 high-value next commands without auto-executing.

nodes.label: Light-on-Dark Perceptual Compensation
nodes.rationale: Compensate light text on dark surfaces across line height, tracking, and weight.

nodes.label: Two Isolated Typographic Assessments
nodes.rationale: Run the typographic design assessment and the mechanical detect --scope type scan independently before synthesizing, so detector hits do not anchor judgment.

nodes.label: Optical Cap-Height Trim and Fallback Size-Adjust
nodes.norm_label: optical cap-height trim and fallback size-adjust
nodes.rationale: Set text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic on a block-level label span inside inline-flex buttons and match fallback metrics with size-adjust (cap height ratio).

nodes.norm_label: last words mobile client (expo router & typescript)

nodes.label: Last Words Dead Man's Switch Platform
nodes.norm_label: last words dead man's switch platform

nodes.label: Midnight Obsidian Vault Design System
nodes.rationale: Solemn, reassuring, high-precision dark aesthetic rooted in cryptographic permanence and quiet vitality built for an automated dead-man's switch where false alarms and early triggers are unacceptable.

nodes.label: Never Fire in Error Principle
nodes.rationale: Inactivity thresholds must prioritize user intent with warnings and grace periods before any message dispatch.

nodes.label: Comp-Led vs Code-Led Build Path
nodes.rationale: Operate and Read surfaces are always code-led; Persuade and Experience default to comp-led when image generation exists, with a decision-page footer toggle to flip per session or update config.

nodes.label: Comp as Measured Spatial Contract
nodes.rationale: An approved comp is a spatial contract rather than a mood board; an on-disk build-phase state machine gates progress by measuring rendered output against the comp.

nodes.label: Painted Material Classification
nodes.rationale: Classify painted material (figures, photos, metal or paper surfaces) as plate, image, or texture instead of code kinds flagged by painted-pixels.

nodes.label: Split Regions by Independent Variance
nodes.rationale: Split regions by swappable content, moving parts, and structural frames/surrounds so overlapping regions composite cleanly and avoid baked-composite flags.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md Frontmatter and Canonical Eight-Section Spec
nodes.norm_label: design.md frontmatter and canonical eight-section spec

nodes.label: Atomic Variant Delivery and Parameter Contract
nodes.norm_label: atomic variant delivery and parameter contract

nodes.label: Motion Evidence Completeness Gate
nodes.rationale: Requires matching normal and reduced-motion report.json files plus before, first, middle, last animated, and settled PNG frames; incomplete or mismatched captures force disposition: recapture.

nodes.label: Named Rules Doctrine Pattern
nodes.rationale: Memorable, citable single-sentence rules (**The [Name] Rule.**) paired with exact values in parens guide AI consumers more reliably than generic bullet lists.

nodes.label: Spatial Thesis, Rhythm, and Density Param
nodes.norm_label: spatial thesis, rhythm, and density param
nodes.rationale: Uses proximity before containers, contrasts tight and generous spacing on a 4-unit base, prefers gap for siblings, and exposes a density range param (--p-density) in live mode.

nodes.label: Two Isolated Layout Assessments
nodes.rationale: Performs a qualitative structural assessment (squint test, grouping, rhythm, topology, density, adaptation, extremes) independently from the mechanical detect --scope layout scan before synthesis.

nodes.label: Carbonize Post-Accept Cleanup and live-complete Gate
nodes.norm_label: carbonize post-accept cleanup and live-complete gate
nodes.rationale: Rewrites temporary stitched @scope styles and variant wrappers into permanent stylesheets, bakes chosen parameter values, and verifies cleanliness via live-complete.

nodes.label: Four-Phase Variant Planning and Identity Lock
nodes.norm_label: four-phase variant planning and identity lock
nodes.rationale: Locks brand identity in one sentence before choosing Default vs Departure mode, commits each variant to a distinct primary axis, and validates against the squint test.

nodes.label: World as Carrier, Not Picture
nodes.rationale: The world may be the carrier of the page with real material coverage while working parts stay functional; a painted poster without working parts or a generic template with a sticker both erase the direction.

nodes.label: Persuade Opening Requirements
nodes.rationale: The opening must make the offer intelligible and desirable, expose a working primary action (never a decorative link), and demonstrate something only this product can prove.

nodes.label: Single Object Form Fidelity
nodes.rationale: When the world is an object, render that one object once at one scale and one point of view, preserving its real physical form without extra copies or impossible folds.

nodes.label: Focus on One Extraordinary Moment
nodes.rationale: Do not layer multiple competing extraordinary moments or mask weak design fundamentals with technical ambition; focus creates impact while excess creates noise.

nodes.label: Progressive Enhancement and 60fps Fallback Discipline
nodes.rationale: Gate bleeding-edge APIs behind feature/adapter checks (WebGPU -> WebGL2 -> CSS, @supports for scroll timelines), maintain 60fps, and pause off-screen rendering.

nodes.label: Propose 2-3 Directions Before Building
nodes.rationale: Think through 2-3 technical/aesthetic directions with browser support, performance, and complexity trade-offs inside the question options and wait for user selection before coding.

nodes.label: Depth Over Competing Performance Rule
nodes.rationale: Commitment is depth via one dominant move plus supporting material, type, and spacing; a second element competing at the same scale is the comp shouting.

nodes.label: Single Approval Point and Prompt Sidecar
nodes.norm_label: single approval point and prompt sidecar

nodes.label: New Visual Work: Create or Replace Visual World
nodes.norm_label: new visual work: create or replace visual world

nodes.label: Visualize: Direction Comps and Asset Production
nodes.norm_label: visualize: direction comps and asset production

nodes.label: Truth Binds Claims, Not Demonstrations
nodes.rationale: Author illustrative demonstration material at full fidelity and label it synthetic where needed, while keeping commercial and factual claims strictly uninventable.

nodes.label: Plates and Embedded Asset Provenance
nodes.rationale: Produce every raster region as a plate before page code and embed the exact generation prompt or origin inside the raster via embed-prompt.

nodes.label: Three Compositional Options Rule
nodes.rationale: Render three distinct high-fidelity comps at the surface's own viewport under .impeccable/mocks/ because one comp invites rubber-stamping and three surface the composition worth building.

nodes.label: Publishing Tradition Transfer
nodes.rationale: Draw from publishing traditions (reference books, type specimens, timetables, field guides, manuals) rather than audience tools or instruments, which become costumes on a reading page.

nodes.label: World Owns the Frame, Calm Reading Column
nodes.norm_label: world owns the frame, calm reading column
nodes.rationale: The world owns the frame (masthead, nav rail, ground, openers, code/table styling) while the reading column stays calm at ~60-75ch measure and ~16px body with standard reading order.

nodes.label: Fixed Rem Scale and Single-Family Typography
nodes.norm_label: fixed rem scale and single-family typography
nodes.rationale: Use a single well-tuned sans family with a tight fixed rem scale (1.125-1.2 ratio) rather than fluid clamp headings; prose stays 65-75ch while tables can run 120ch+.

nodes.label: State-Conveying Motion (150-250ms)
nodes.rationale: Use 150-250ms transitions solely to convey state change, feedback, loading, or reveal without orchestrated page-load sequences.

nodes.label: Overlay Container Escape Pattern
nodes.rationale: Overlays inside overflow: hidden or auto ancestors get clipped; use <dialog>, the Popover API, position: fixed, or a portal so overlays escape their container.

nodes.label: Product Slop Test and Earned Familiarity
nodes.norm_label: product slop test and earned familiarity
nodes.rationale: In task UI, familiarity is a feature; the failure mode is purposeless strangeness (over-decorated buttons, invented affordances), so the tool should disappear into the task.

nodes.label: Foundations Web UI and Operations Checklist
nodes.norm_label: foundations web ui and operations checklist

nodes.label: Multi-Harness Hook Manifest Wiring and Consent
nodes.norm_label: multi-harness hook manifest wiring and consent

nodes.label: Foundations Security and Design Quality Gates
nodes.norm_label: foundations security and design quality gates
nodes.rationale: Verifies secrets-out-of-repo, readable-contrast, no-generic-ai-patterns, design-tokens, and reduced-motion using real implementations rather than empty stubs.

nodes.label: Hook Finding Triage and Narrow Ignore Policy
nodes.norm_label: hook finding triage and narrow ignore policy
nodes.rationale: Prefers fixing real issues and restricts self-served exceptions to evidence-backed ignore-value entries, requiring user confirmation for ignore-file or ignore-rule.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Design Detector Hook
nodes.rationale: Surfaces mechanical defects immediately on edit and defers taste, copy cadence, and layout rhythm checks to a deduplicated Stop deep pass where supported.

nodes.label: Single-Command Live-Generate Boot
nodes.rationale: Reuses an already running dev server and browser tab via impeccable live-generate --boot --wait-for-browser and forbids inventing session ids or running init/document inline.

nodes.label: Workflow Default: Comp-First vs Code-First (buildPath)
nodes.rationale: Stores an explicit user answer for comp vs code workflow in .impeccable/config.json when image generation is available; never fabricates a standing default from silence or writes it to PRODUCT.md.

nodes.label: Live Mode Boot, Poll Loop, and Journal Recovery
nodes.norm_label: live mode boot, poll loop, and journal recovery
nodes.rationale: Boots via impeccable live, runs a long-timeout live-poll loop dispatching generate/steer/accept/discard/manual_edit_apply/exit events, and recovers durable session state from .impeccable/live/sessions/.

nodes.label: Namespaced Onboarding Storage Pattern
nodes.rationale: Namespace localStorage onboarding and tooltip keys by account id and version so shared browsers do not hide onboarding across accounts.

nodes.label: Show, Don't Tell and Context Over Ceremony
nodes.norm_label: show, don't tell and context over ceremony
nodes.rationale: Demonstrate with working examples and real functionality at the point of use via progressive disclosure instead of a separate tutorial mode.

nodes.label: Time to Value and Aha Moment
nodes.norm_label: time to value and aha moment
nodes.rationale: Onboarding should get users to their aha moment as fast as possible by teaching the 20% that delivers 80% of value rather than teaching everything upfront.

nodes.label: Asset Loading (WebP/AVIF, Code Splitting, Font Subsetting)
nodes.norm_label: asset loading (webp/avif, code splitting, font subsetting)

nodes.label: Batch Reads and Writes to Avoid Layout Thrashing
nodes.norm_label: batch reads and writes to avoid layout thrashing
nodes.rationale: Batch all DOM geometry reads before DOM writes because alternating reads and writes forces synchronous layout reflows.

nodes.label: GPU-Accelerated Animation and 60fps Budget
nodes.rationale: Target 16ms/60fps using transform and opacity while bounding expensive blur/filter/shadow paint areas and avoiding casual animation of layout properties.

nodes.label: Measure Before and After Optimization
nodes.rationale: Identify actual bottlenecks and measure before and after on real devices and slow networks rather than optimizing prematurely.

nodes.label: Doctor Severity Routing and Deprecated Fields
nodes.norm_label: doctor severity routing and deprecated fields
nodes.rationale: Separates auto-fixable schema drift (--fix), mention-only notices, and route findings handed to init/document; treats deprecated fields like ## Register as bindingly absent.

nodes.label: Scan Mode vs Seed Mode
nodes.rationale: Scan mode auto-extracts incumbent design tokens and confirms qualitative language with the user; Seed mode routes pre-implementation projects through new-work to record a minimal directional seed without fabricating tokens.

nodes.label: Product Truth Interview and Platform Hypothesis
nodes.norm_label: product truth interview and platform hypothesis
nodes.rationale: Scans repo evidence first, forms a platform hypothesis (web/ios/android/adaptive), and interviews in max-3-question rounds without inventing visual worlds or aesthetic directions.

nodes.label: Server Runtime Error Log (Prisma, JWT, Zod)
nodes.norm_label: server runtime error log (prisma, jwt, zod)

nodes.label: Platform-Aware Session Hardening & Redis Token Blacklist
nodes.norm_label: platform-aware session hardening & redis token blacklist
nodes.rationale: Mobile clients receive prolonged sliding refresh tokens with silent background refresh while web clients use short-lived sessions; logout blacklists active access tokens in Redis under revoked_token:<token>.

nodes.label: Raster Plate & Transparent Cutout Production Pipeline
nodes.norm_label: raster plate & transparent cutout production pipeline
nodes.rationale: Regenerates raster regions at >=1.5x resolution from comp crops with UI chrome removed and native alpha for cutouts, avoiding blurry crops or chroma-key artifacts.

nodes.label: Comp-Led Plan and Asset Review Checkpoint
nodes.norm_label: comp-led plan and asset review checkpoint
nodes.rationale: Catches misclassified raster vs code regions before full page coding by letting the user inspect plates and code-region plans against the approved comp.

nodes.label: Complexity Assessment and Essence Finding
nodes.rationale: Simplicity removes obstacles between users and their single primary goal rather than stripping necessary features or accessibility.

nodes.label: Six Simplification Dimensions
nodes.rationale: Removes excess across Information Architecture, Visual, Layout, Interaction, Content, and Code dimensions while preserving hierarchy, usability, and ARIA.

nodes.label: Three-Use Pattern Extraction Heuristic
nodes.rationale: Only extract components, tokens, or patterns repeated 3+ times with identical intent because premature abstraction is worse than duplication.

nodes.label: iOS System Primitives and Simulator Verification
nodes.norm_label: ios system primitives and simulator verification

nodes.label: The iOS Slop Test and HIG Conformance
nodes.norm_label: the ios slop test and hig conformance
nodes.rationale: Native iOS apps must never feel ported from a website; HIG governs navigation, safe areas, and system controls while brand expresses through tint, typography, motion, and content.

nodes.label: Operate Mode Comp and Organization Variant Standards
nodes.norm_label: operate mode comp and organization variant standards
nodes.rationale: Operate comps use real domain data, standard interactive controls, and vary screen organization (side rail, top bar, command-first) rather than adding world ornament or costume.

nodes.label: Four-Contribution World Limit for Operate Surfaces
nodes.norm_label: four-contribution world limit for operate surfaces
nodes.rationale: On Operate surfaces, the aesthetic world contributes only type, palette, density, and one concrete signature move while layout, navigation, and controls stay standard to the platform.

nodes.norm_label: shape: discovery interview and design brief

nodes.label: Two-Round Discovery Cadence
nodes.rationale: Ask 2-3 related questions per round (purpose/people/outcome first, material/behavior/boundaries second if needed) without dumping questionnaires or asking for CSS values.

nodes.label: Stop Before Code or Contract
nodes.rationale: Shape presents the brief for explicit confirmation or one correction round and stops without writing code, direction contracts, or persistence.

nodes.label: Page-Scale Color Strategy Selection
nodes.rationale: Pick Restrained, Committed, Full palette, or Drenched before picking colors, and commit color at page scale across whole regions rather than scattering accents over neutral ground.

nodes.label: Restrained Color and State-Rich Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Default to Restrained color with standardized semantic states (hover, focus, active, disabled, selected, loading, error, warning, success, info) and reserve accent for actions, selection, and states.
